India's GST Revenue Surges Past ₹2 Lakh Crore in September

Goods and Services Tax (GST) revenue in India surpassed ₹2 lakh crore in September. Andhra Pradesh specifically recorded a 14.10% increase in its GST collections for the same month. This marks a significant rise in national tax revenue.
